Looking at the quotation:

The specific mechanism is: **government funding to a national body (NFCC) to study/improve recruitment and retention of on-call (volunteer/part-time) fire service personnel**.

This is about government expenditure directed at a public safety/emergency service workforce issue, channeled through a grant/funding arrangement to a national coordinating body.

Checking the codes:
- H81 (Governmental Loans, Loan Guarantees, Credits, Grants, Bailouts) — the mechanism is funding/grants to NFCC
- H56 (National Security and War) — fire services are public safety but not military
- H76 (State and Local Government: Other Expenditure Categories) — fire services are often local, but this is national-level funding
- H57 (Procurement) — not procurement
- H84 (Disaster Aid) — not disaster aid per se
- H83 (Public Administration) — the NFCC coordination aspect has some fit here

The core mechanism is a government grant to a national body (NFCC) to address workforce (recruitment/retention) in fire services. H81 (Governmental Grants) fits the instrument well. However, the substance is about fire service staffing — a public safety expenditure matter. H76 covers "other expenditure categories" at local/state level for services like fire.

Given fire services are typically local and this is intergovernmental funding coordination, H76 is a reasonable fit. But H81 (grants) matches the instrument most precisely as named.
